title: ConvoLearn: A Dataset of Constructivist Tutor-Student Dialogue
reasoning: The paper's Knowledge-Building framework and the resulting dataset explicitly include 'Moral Responsibility' as a sub-dimension of Accountability. This is defined as supporting students in recognizing ethical and societal impacts and discussing ethical dilemmas (e.g., in the context of climate change), which is then used as a criterion for evaluating and fine-tuning the AI tutor dialogues.
